title: Computational homogenization of unsteady flows in a periodic porous medium
summary: The work is devoted to the development and computational implementation of the homogenization method for modeling unsteady flows of a viscous incompressible fluid in periodic porous media taking into account memory effects. At the macrolevel, the flow is described by an integro-differential Darcy law with a tensor memory kernel determined by solving unsteady problems on the periodicity cell. The developed approach to computational homogenization is based on finding the steady-state and unsteady components of the conductivity tensor from solving auxiliary boundary value and spectral problems…
